_comment: Family manifest for the K2-V3 size-family report. Add one entry per model as its run lands, then rerun generate_latex.py + generate_family.py. 'key' is the model's identity in \famnum{<key>}{<stat>} lookups, table columns, and chart legends. 'size_b' is the parameter count in billions (x-axis of the scaling charts; may be null). 'results_dir' is repo-relative and must contain exactly one model's result files. Baselines appear only in the UAE comparison table, never in family aggregates or scaling charts.
_comparisons_comment: Full-suite VERSION comparisons against the largest family model (the anchor). Shown in the version-comparison table/chart + movers, but NOT in family aggregates or size-scaling curves (they are not size points). Re-scored with the same fixed scorers/judge as the family on the tasks that changed.
